summary: The architecture is sound and the security boundary is real: company-scope.ts's requireCompanyScope() enforces a genuine membership check (parameterized Drizzle query, not string-built SQL) before any companyId is used as the VERIDIAN organizationId, which is also the per-org API-key selector, so cross-company data leakage via a guessed org UUID is actually prevented and is covered by tests. The Company->Department->Project drill-down, date-range filtering, and category charts are wired to real existing VERIDIAN data sources rather than fabricated ones, tests are meaningful (scoping boundaries, percentage math, passthrough behavior), and no .github/workflows/** files are touched so the hard rule is not implicated. However, this diff should not be merged as-is: one of the two headline deliverables in the task (the BOQ category-distribution pie/bar charts) is wired to a VERIDIAN endpoint (GET /v1/projexa/reports/category-boq-amounts) that does not exist yet in production -- it lives only on an unpushed local branch in the compliance-tracker checkout, explicitly disclosed in PROGRESS.md as not pushed pending sign-off. If this PROJEXA PR is merged now, every user who opens a project's detail view will hit a real backend failure on that chart, and the client-side code (CategoryDistributionCharts.tsx) collapses that failure into the same message as a legitimately empty project ('No BOQ line items found for this project yet.'), which is misleading rather than a clear 'feature pending' state. A secondary, lower-severity issue: the date-ranged revenue calculation in the project-details route silently caps at 4 pages / 800 invoices per request with no truncation signal returned to the caller, so a high-volume org's date-ranged revenue figure could be silently undercounted. Recommend holding this PR, pushing/deploying the compliance-tracker category-boq-amounts companion change first (or shipping a distinguishable 'not yet available' UI state as a stopgap), then re-reviewing.
issues: Category-distribution charts (one of the two headline chart deliverables) depend on a VERIDIAN endpoint (/v1/projexa/reports/category-boq-amounts) that is not pushed/deployed -- merging now ships a feature that will fail for every project until a separate, unmerged compliance-tracker change lands.

CategoryDistributionCharts.tsx treats a failed fetch (e.g. the 502 this dependency gap will cause) identically to a genuinely empty category list, showing the misleading message 'No BOQ line items found for this project yet.' instead of a distinct error/pending state.

revenueForProjectInRange() in the project-details route silently caps at MAX_INVOICE_PAGES=4 (800 invoices) per date-ranged request with no indication returned to the caller if the cap was hit, risking a silently undercounted revenue figure for high-invoice-volume orgs.

No live browser verification of the new pages was performed (disclosed by the worker) -- recommend a manual smoke test of /dashboard/hierarchy and /dashboard/overview before considering this feature-complete.
No .github/workflows/** files are touched by this diff, so the hard rule against workflow-file changes is not implicated.
